title: The Defensible Core: Infant Circumcision, Consent, and the Spinoza Off-Ramp
subtitle: Everything needed for the essay — stripped of group-blame, kept to what survives scrutiny

1_personal_harm.title: Personal Harm
points: Circumcised as an infant in a hospital without parental permission
PTSD over circumcision — 'I had/have PTSD over circumcision, so now you know one'
Nearly all infants experience this; it is misdiagnosed later in life
The only men who are 'happy' about being circumcised are the coping ones who don't realize they're missing over half their sensation

2_consent_argument.title: Consent Argument
points: Children cannot consent to circumcision — same standard as sexual consent
Proxy consent implodes under pediatric standards
Lancet/JAMA: non-therapeutic infant circumcision violates bodily integrity
UN Convention on the Rights of the Child cited
KNMG (Royal Dutch Medical Association): defer to age 16
Vaccination analogy fails — vaccines are reversible, circumcision is permanent
AAFP: tissue is valuable; removal is unethical

3_medical_claims.title: Medical Claims (contested but arguable)
points: 200-300% cortisol spikes (PMC 2025)
Links to rage, dissociation, attachment insecurity, alexithymia
20-30% adult resentment (Frontiers 2025)
13-27% parental regret (Journal of Pediatric Urology 2024-25)
Possible sensitivity reduction (International Journal of Impotence Research)
Community studies: complications up to 12.37% including adhesions
Benefits (UTI/HIV reduction) are context-dependent, manageable via hygiene
3_medical_claims.caveat: The trauma-to-psychopathy-to-conquest chain is a hypothesis, not established fact. The cortisol and PTSD evidence is real; the population-level violence leap is not.

4_legal_hooks.title: Legal Hooks (real but untested)
points: 14th Amendment due process: bodily integrity
1st Amendment free exercise does not cover irreversible harm to others
Bob Jones precedent: illegal purpose voids 501(c)(3) tax exemption
Hadrian's circumcision ban (historical precedent)
FGM ban survived free-exercise challenge — same logic should extend to boys

5_ai_audit_work.title: AI Audit Work
points: Two blind scans of 58 Grokipedia circumcision articles: 77% and 85% pro-circumcision lean, no article flipping
SteelMenCollider: generalized dialectical framework for ethically charged topics
SteelManAbraham: circumcision debate turned into 'radioactive glass'
Grokipedia ratio shifted from 60/15/25 to 50/20/30 after submissions

6_spinoza_position.title: Spinoza Position — The Off-Ramp
points: 'I wish I could be antisemitic but I love Spinoza too much'
Ben Gurion on Spinoza; Spinoza as the greatest theologian; Hebrew pride stance
Spinoza's conatus (Ethics III Prop 6) undermined by proxy consent
The off-ramp: keep the community, drop the cut — drop the excommunication, keep the identity, stop cutting infants
Pluralistic ignorance explains why circumcised societies don't question circumcision — and why the one person who notices gets treated as the outlier

hazing_mechanism.title: The Hazing Mechanism (strongest version of the argument)
points: Circumcision is a painful, irreversible initiation that binds the initiate to the group and makes questioning it feel like betrayal
It describes circumcision exactly — and it describes fraternity pledges, military boot camp, and FGM equally well
The mechanism is real. The leap from 'circumcision is hazing' to 'Jews are a cult' is where it stops being an argument about a practice and becomes an argument about a people.
Hazing doesn't require a people — it requires a practice. You can condemn the hazing without condemning everyone who was hazed.

what_to_delete.title: Group-Blame Posts to Remove (they make the essay radioactive)
items: 'Circumcision is Judaism is infant gang rape torture'
'The Nazis were the Zionists also. And, still are.'
'BMC' (baby mutilation cult) as a replacement term for Jews
'Abrahamic religion is the single biggest reason we can't have safe superintelligence'
'Christianity is 100% for Jewish survival turned supremacy as a servant ideology'
The three-step argument: circumcision induces psychopathic traits → psychopathy drives theft/rape/murder → biblical promise as conquest strategy
'All three are Jews. Jews just means Abrahamic cultist. Or baby skinner.'
what_to_delete.reason: A reader who hits any of these stops reading the consent argument. The consent argument is the one that could actually change something.
